title: EXP route read cost (W1 stop gate D-1)
question: Live look-through reads 9.3 rows per holding, not 2.7. Choose: (c) W1 rev 2 tries a leaner query, then cap at ≤50k rows using the newly measured ratio; ETFs over the cap show "too large for live look-through in November" (recommended). (a) cap now at ~5,000 holdings (refuses VXUS, AGG, MBB, SPAB, BNDX, BND). (b) keep 15,000 and allow up to ~140k reads per call (breaks the three-point check 50k rule; not recommended).
